problem: Security-auditing a codebase with an AI agent can produce unverified or made-up findings. This skill gives an agent a structured, multi-phase audit process for people reviewing a repo.

stack.backend: Markdown prompt files and JavaScript (.cjs) validation scripts
stack.ai: Coding-agent skill that runs many isolated agents (hunters, verifiers)
stack.deploy: Agent skill folder (skills/security-audit) added to a coding agent

whatsNew: Every candidate bug goes to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it, and results are saved as machine-checked records with a JSON schema. A coverage ledger tracks which parts were checked, and later runs add to earlier ones.
